blocks.text: Zscaler Authentication Service provides centralized authentication and identity management across Zscaler products. By using Zscaler products, you provide Zscaler the right to process, use, reproduce, store, modify, and display the information from logs. For Authentication Service, Audit Logs are defined as follows:

blocks.item: Definition: Activity records of configuration and authentication changes made within a Zscaler administrative UI or API. Audit Logs include administrator and user sign-in and sign-out attempts, including unsuccessful attempts. To learn more, see About Audit Logs.

Retention: Zscaler retains Audit Log information for a rolling period of six months during the subscription term. When the subscription term ends or expires, the logs are deleted by Zscaler according to the applicable retention period.
Storage: During the deployment process, you can choose to have the Audit Logs stored in the United States, European Union, or India.
